global_stop_audit.disposition: Freeze evidence, issue WAVE1_REPEAT, do not merge to the main branch, do not start Wave 2, submit the two-option analysis to the PI (CP6).

option_A_continue_repeat.description: Launch another preregistered remediation loop targeting the four remaining REPEAT subgates.
option_A_continue_repeat.scientific_gain_assessment: LOW. No diagnosed implementation defect remains. Flipping A2 requires gain redesign (only allowed as a preregistered analytic redesign, since tuning on the plant is forbidden); flipping E/F requires replacing the frozen T1 anchor (out-of-URDF by preregistered design) and the frozen T3 rate demand, i.e. new scenarios, which constitutes a new experiment rather than a remediation; flipping D-C2 requires a new hypothesis (orientation- or task-weighted) which must be preregistered as new science. None of these corrects an error; they change the question.
option_A_continue_repeat.cost_and_risk: Another full matrix cycle (about 40 min compute plus agent cycles) before the 2026-09-01 deadline; each further loop against known results erodes the preregistration discipline (design-to-pass risk explicitly forbidden by preregistration item 2).

option_B_close_with_documented_negatives.description: Accept the four remaining REPEAT subgates as final documented negative results per preregistration item 1 (they enter the paper as honest findings), close Wave 1 at governance level (CP6), and scope any scenario redesign as new Wave-2 preregistrations.
option_B_close_with_documented_negatives.scientific_gain_assessment: HIGH. The negatives are informative: frozen-gain feedback lag quantified against a plant-fidelity diagnostic; feedforward/nullspace null results established with a fair comparator; the frozen benchmark's infeasibility against PROVISIONAL flight-class limits quantified. These are publishable characterizations of the capture-control design space.
option_B_close_with_documented_negatives.cost_and_risk: The wave1 verdict remains WAVE1_REPEAT on the frozen rule; closing requires an explicit PI record (CP6) stating that the REPEAT set is accepted as negative-result science, so that no later reader mistakes it for unresolved defects.

two_option_analysis_for_PI.integrator_recommendation: Option B, with W1-R12/W1-R13 carried into the hardware-parameter round and any T1-anchor split or rate-feasible T3 redesign preregistered as new Wave-2 experiments. Final authority: PI (CP6).

repeat_requirements_if_option_A: Preregister an analytic (not plant-tuned) gain redesign before any A2 rerun.
Preregister a URDF-feasible operational T1 anchor split from the 19.20 deg benchmark anchor.
Preregister a rate-feasible T3 corridor consistent with the 0.12 m/s disturbance-bound assumption or preregister a revised bound derivation.
Preregister any new C2/C3 hypothesis (orientation- or task-weighted) as new science, not as remediation.
No threshold, scenario, or negative-result rewriting under preregistration items 1-2.
